Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the governor's official inaugural ball committee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to governors' inaugural balls; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.34 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The governor's official inaugural ball committee is created forthe purpose of planning and organizing governors' official inauguralballs. (2) The committee shall be composed of: (a) Two individuals appointed by the Democratic nominee forgovernor; (b) Two individuals appointed by the Republican nominee forgovernor; (c) Four legislators appointed as follows: (i) One appointed by the speaker of the house of representatives; (ii) One appointed by the majority leader of the senate; (iii) One appointed by the minority leader of the house ofrepresentatives; and (iv) One appointed by the minority leader of the senate; p. 1 HB 1205 (d) One representative of the state supreme court; (e) One representative of statewide elected officials; and (f) The director of enterprise services. (3) The committee shall select a chair from among its members. (4)(a) Governors' official inaugural balls shall be held on thecapitol campus in January of years following gubernatorial elections. (b) The department of enterprise services must grant fee waiversand negotiate rental rates with the committee. (c) The Washington state patrol shall be in charge of security forthe event. (d) The event is a private event, with admission only by ticket. (5) The committee may: (a) Hire a staff person to oversee and assist with the event; (b) Raise money, including seeking financial donations; and (c) Seek volunteers to assist in all aspects of the event. (6) The governor's official inaugural ball account is created inthe custody of the state treasurer. All receipts from fundraising anddonations under this section must be deposited into the account.Expenditures from the account may be used only for the governor'sofficial inaugural ball. Only the chair of the governor's officialinaugural ball committee or the chair's designee may authorizeexpenditures from the account. The account is subject to allotmentprocedures under chapter 43.88 RCW, but an appropriation is notrequired for expenditures.
